description: This file defines a React component `ExecutionWebhookActivity` that displays webhook activity details for a specific workflow execution, including webhook events, status badges, and a retry button.

methods.name: sortEvents
methods.description: Sorts webhook events in descending order based on creation time.

methods.name: getStatusTone
methods.description: Returns a tone ('success', 'danger', 'muted') based on webhook event status and error presence.
